channel.title: Miami Sports Desk
channel.description: Daily morning roundup and 30-minute pregame drops for the Dolphins, Hurricanes, Heat, Panthers, Marlins, Inter Miami and FIU, built from the reporters who cover them.
channel.itunes:author: Hark

item.title: Morning Roundup: Tue, Oct 13 — Hafley sticks with Willis
item.description: The 0-5 Dolphins enter the bye with Malik Willis still the starter, the Canes get four defenders back for FSU, and the Panthers lost Markström early in a 5-3 loss at Buffalo. Tonight: Panthers at Columbus at 6:15 and FIU at Jacksonville State at 8.
